$comment: Atlanta seeds (D-040). Public calendars only; each is read through robots.txt, the denylist and the noindex/login checks, so a wrong or blocked URL costs one request and shows up as a skip in the dry run. 'verified': true means a live run read the endpoint (dry runs 41849155715 and 41856949627) or the URL was confirmed in D-039; false means the endpoint was inferred from the site's platform and public search results and has not been opened from the authoring environment (no outbound access). Seeds a site answered with 403, or with no machine-readable feed at all, are enabled: false with the reason in note. Georgia State is left out because the D-037 importer already reads its Localist calendar and PIN.

seeds.name: Fulton County Library System events
seeds.attribution: Listed from the Fulton County Library System public calendar (fulcolibrary.org).
seeds.note: Off (review of the hardening commits): BiblioCommons-hosted library site. dry run 41849155715: crawl_delay_too_long (robots.txt Crawl-delay over 60 s). BiblioCommons documents no public events feed, its terms of use could not be read from the authoring environment, and a Crawl-delay that long on a vendor platform reads as a request not to be crawled. Re-enable only with a published feed (or written permission) from the Fulton County Library System or BiblioCommons; then prefer a feed seed.

Trumba publishes ICS/RSS at trumba.com/calendars/<web name>.ics, but Emory's web name is not public; off until Emory Communications (theweb@emory.edu) gives it (D-039), then switch to kind ics.

seeds.name: Kennesaw State University public calendar
seeds.attribution: Listed from the Kennesaw State University public events calendar (calendar.kennesaw.edu).
seeds.note: Localist (confirmed by dry run 41849155715: 351 items from pages, plus /event/*/confirm and calendar.google.com links that are now skipped). Reads Localist's documented read-only API (/api/2/events, no key; developer.localist.com/doc/api) instead of crawling. Academic-calendar deadlines are dropped. Terms: the developer docs say reading needs no key, but Concept3D help says API use needs a license; Kennesaw State is the licensee and the data is public, but ask Kennesaw State for permission as D-037 does for Georgia State, and switch back to kind page if they say no. diagnose dry run 41856949627: the API read works.
